title: Japan earthquake aftermath: Woman dies of heat stroke in parked car; toll rises to 36
summary_full: An elderly woman died from heat stroke while sheltering in her car after a massive earthquake. Authorities are warning of growing heat-related risks for evacuees amid sweltering temperatures. Thousands remain displaced, with many sleeping in cars or outside their homes for privacy. Temperatures are climbing, raising fears of further heat-related illnesses among survivors. The government is rushing essential supplies to evacuation centers to improve living conditions.
